description: This line plot illustrates the loss over the number of iterations for six different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000, with numeric tick labels positioned at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and employs a linear scale with a range from 2.4 to 3.4, marked by tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot features six solid lines, none of which use markers, and each is surrounded by a lighter, semi-transparent shaded region of its respective color. All lines exhibit a similar overall pattern, characterized by a steep, rapid decline near zero iterations originating from above the 3.4 upper limit of the y-axis, followed by a gradual, steady decrease across the remainder of the x-axis. The solid purple line representing "Vanilla" steadily decreases to end at approximately 2.46 at 140,000 iterations. The solid blue line for "StrmLLM (n=64)" decreases but maintains the highest position on the graph, ending at roughly 2.61. The solid orange line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64)," declines to conclude near 2.52. The solid green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)" closely follows the orange trajectory, finishing slightly lower at approximately 2.51. The solid red line representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" continues the downward trend to end near 2.49. Finally, the solid dark blue line for "SepLLM (n=128)" closely tracks the trajectory of the purple Vanilla line, concluding its steady decline at approximately 2.47 at the 140,000 iteration mark.
